q: QPR won automatic promotion from Division Two in 2003-04 as runners-up. Which club finished above them as champions?
hint: The Devon club took the title on 90 points, with Bristol City finishing third, a single point behind QPR.

q: Which manager led QPR to the Championship title and promotion to the Premier League in 2010-11?
hint: He arrived from Crystal Palace in March 2010, and was sacked in January 2012 during the club's first season back in the top flight.

q: QPR were back at Wembley for the 1986 League Cup final, then sponsored as the Milk Cup. Which club beat them 3-0?
hint: It remains the only major trophy won by the Manor Ground club, under manager Maurice Evans.

q: QPR broke their transfer record in January 2013 to sign a defender from Anzhi Makhachkala. Who was he?
hint: The £12.5m fee could not save Rangers, who finished bottom of the table on 25 points that season.

q: QPR won the 2014 Championship play-off final at Wembley. Which club did they beat?
hint: The beaten side dominated possession and were managed by Steve McClaren, who called it the cruellest game ever.

q: Who scored the 90th-minute goal that won QPR the 2014 Championship play-off final at Wembley?
hint: The veteran striker struck from the edge of the box with almost the last kick of the game against Derby County.
